versions.changelog:
seedance-ad-creative 2.0.0

- Upgraded to require ofox-video-core v2.0.0 or newer. All billable actions now require explicit --approved flag for safer API usage.
- Updated documentation to clarify dependency requirements and safe usage with newer core versions.
- Removed legacy file: skill-card.md.
- Version number advanced to reflect core compatibility and breaking changes.

seedance-ad-creative 1.13.7

- Updated version to 1.13.7 in SKILL.md and metadata for consistency.
- Removed the unused or obsolete skill-card.md file. 
- No user-facing workflow changes; documentation and metadata maintenance only.

seedance-ad-creative v1.13.4

- Updated version and metadata references to 1.13.4.
- Removed the deprecated documentation file skill-card.md.
- Minor documentation cleanup; no user-facing feature or behavior changes.

seedance-ad-creative 1.13.3

- Updated version metadata to 1.13.3 in SKILL.md and related fields.
- Removed redundant file skill-card.md.
- No functional or logic changes; documentation and versioning refresh only.

seedance-ad-creative v1.13.0

- Updated SKILL.md version and metadata to 1.13.0.
- Removed outdated skill-card.md file.
- General documentation and metadata updates for accuracy and consistency.

seedance-ad-creative 1.12.1

- Added explicit instructions for resolving the core ofox-video-core skill directory, improving compatibility across different skill pack layouts.
- Updated SKILL.md to clarify what to do if the core script is not found and adjusted directory handling in documentation.
- Incremented skill version to 1.12.1 in metadata.
- Removed obsolete skill-card.md file.

- Added detailed documentation on creative brief and prompt structure tailored for ad-creative scenarios.
- Clarified new and updated axis-specific user questions for ad video generation (photo, tone, camera move, aspect).
- Emphasized the required use-case boundaries (not for dialogue-driven scenes).
- Outlined improved instructions for managing input paths, defaults, and cost estimates.
- Updated environment and dependency requirements, including OFOX_API_KEY, curl, and jq.
